question: The length of the altitude of an equilateral triangle is 6sqrt 3 m. The perimeter of the equilateral triangle (in m) is:
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Height = (asqrt3 )/(2)

**Calculations:**

Let the side of the triangle be a m

Height = (asqrt3 )/(2)

Side = (Htimes 2)/(sqrt3) [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] 

Side = (6sqrt3times 2)/(sqrt3)

Side = 12 m

Perimeter

= 12 × 3

= 36 m 

Hence, The Required value is 36 m
